title: Dream4ACT: A Shared Visual Action Interface for Multi-Embodiment Video-Action Modeling
title_zh: Dream4ACT：一种用于多具身视频动作建模的共享视觉动作接口

paragraphs.en: Video–action world models offer a promising foundation for embodied intelligence by connecting visual prediction with robot control. A general model should support two complementary directions: predicting future observations under candidate controls and inferring controls consistent with observed or desired future observations. Large-scale video pretraining provides spatiotemporal priors ( Wan et al., 2025 ) , motivating growing interest in adapting video models for robot prediction and control ( Cheang et al., 2024 ; Li et al., 2026b ) .
paragraphs.zh: 视频–动作世界模型通过将视觉预测与机器人控制相连接，为具身智能提供了有前景的基础。 通用模型应支持两个互补的方向：在候选控制条件下预测未来观测，以及推断与已观测或期望的未来观测相一致的控制。 大规模视频预训练提供了时空先验（Wan 等， 2025），这激发了将视频模型适配于机器人预测与控制的日益浓厚的兴趣（Cheang 等， 2024；Li 等， 2026b）。

sents.en: Video–action world models offer a promising foundation for embodied intelligence by connecting visual prediction with robot control.

sents.zh: 大规模视频预训练提供了时空先验（Wan 等， 2025），这激发了将视频模型适配于机器人预测与控制的日益浓厚的兴趣（Cheang 等， 2024；Li 等， 2026b）。

paragraphs.en: Recent works use video models either to provide visual plans or predictive features for a separate controller ( Du et al., 2023 ; Hu et al., 2024 ) , or to jointly predict observations and actions, often through modality-specific heads ( Li et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2026b ) . Joint-space vectors lack explicit spatial structure and vary across embodiments. Shared policies support heterogeneous action spaces ( Team et al., 2024 ; Liu et al., 2025 ) , while latent-frame encodings reuse video generation for action prediction ( Kim et al., 2026 ) . Visual interfaces further represent end-effector quantities as images ( Li et al., 2026c ; Zhen et al., 2026 ) , but do not explicitly encode the full arm configuration. Executing these end-effector commands still requires an embodiment-specific mapping to joint targets, potentially with singular solutions or no solutions.
paragraphs.zh: 近期的工作要么使用视频模型为单独的控制器提供视觉规划或预测特征（Du et al., 2023；Hu et al., 2024），要么通过模态专属的输出头联合预测观测与动作（Li et al., 2025；Li et al., 2026b）。 关节空间向量缺乏显式的空间结构，并且在不同本体之间各不相同。 共享策略可支持异构的动作空间（Team et al., 2024；Liu et al., 2025），而潜在帧编码则复用视频生成来进行动作预测（Kim et al., 2026）。 视觉接口进一步将末端执行器的量表示为图像（Li et al., 2026c；Zhen et al., 2026），但并未显式编码完整的机械臂构型。 执行这些末端执行器指令仍需要一个与本体相关的映射来得到关节目标，这可能存在奇异解或无解的情况。

paragraphs.en: Our key insight is to represent target articulated configurations as visual content modeled alongside RGB observations. For joint-controlled manipulation, we seek a shared visual interface that retains arm and gripper configuration information, supports joint training across embodiments, and permits recovery of executable joint targets.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的核心洞察是将目标铰接构型表示为与RGB观测一同建模的视觉内容。 对于关节控制的操作任务，我们寻求一种共享的视觉接口，它能保留机械臂和夹爪的构型信息，支持跨具身形态的联合训练，并允许恢复出可执行的关节目标。

sents.en: Our key insight is to represent target articulated configurations as visual content modeled alongside RGB observations.
sents.zh: 我们的核心洞察是将目标铰接构型表示为与RGB观测一同建模的视觉内容。

sents.en: For joint-controlled manipulation, we seek a shared visual interface that retains arm and gripper configuration information, supports joint training across embodiments, and permits recovery of executable joint targets.
sents.zh: 对于关节控制的操作任务，我们寻求一种共享的视觉接口，它能保留机械臂和夹爪的构型信息，支持跨具身形态的联合训练，并允许恢复出可执行的关节目标。

paragraphs.en: We instantiate this interface as action views : multiview images of target joint configurations obtained through URDF-based forward kinematics and rendering. Unlike observation-aligned robot renderings ( Chen et al., 2026 ; Gu et al., 2026 ) , our fixed virtual cameras are independent of physical observation cameras, removing the need for physical-camera extrinsic calibration in action-view construction. Saved camera presets remain fixed throughout training and inference, with consistent view roles across embodiments. A fixed tensor shape enables shared tokenization and prediction across embodiments, while the rendered articulated geometry preserves the information needed for configuration matching. Joint targets are then recovered by training-free, URDF-constrained optimization, without a learned embodiment-specific action decoder.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将此接口实例化为动作视图：通过基于URDF的正向运动学与渲染得到的目标关节配置多视图图像。 与观测对齐的机器人渲染（Chen et al., 2026; Gu et al., 2026）不同，我们的固定虚拟相机独立于物理观测相机，从而在动作视图构建中无需进行物理相机外参标定。 保存的相机预设在整个训练与推理过程中保持固定，并在不同本体间保持一致的视图角色。 固定的张量形状使得不同本体间可以共享分词与预测，而渲染出的关节几何则保留了配置匹配所需的信息。 随后通过免训练的、受URDF约束的优化恢复关节目标，而无需学习特定本体的动作解码器。

paragraphs.en: Building on this representation, Dream4ACT jointly models physical-camera observations and four action-view streams with a shared video autoencoder and diffusion transformer, conditioned on instruction-grounded scene features. Masked flow matching selects future conditioning and prediction streams, enabling forward dynamics, inverse dynamics, and joint generation with shared weights across jointly trained embodiments. Our model achieves 88.98% average success on RoboTwin 2.0 and a TriWorldBench score of 65.66 using a separately trained checkpoint; closed-loop evaluations cover five simulated embodiments and four real-world platforms. A separately trained ablation compares action-view rendering with camera-aligned skeleton conditioning on the same recorded joint-state sequences. Together, these evaluations demonstrate the interface’s strong capabilities both as a generated representation recoverable into executable commands and as a conditioning signal for future RGB prediction.
paragraphs.zh: 基于这一表示，Dream4ACT 在共享视频自编码器和扩散Transformer的框架下，联合建模物理相机观测与四个动作视图流，并以基于指令的场景特征作为条件。 掩码流匹配用于选择未来的条件流和预测流，使前向动力学、逆向动力学和联合生成能够在联合训练的具身之间以共享权重实现。 我们的模型在 RoboTwin 2.0 上取得了 88.98% 的平均成功率，并使用单独训练的检查点取得了 65.66 的 TriWorldBench 分数；闭环评估覆盖五个仿真具身和四个真实世界平台。 一项单独训练的消融实验在同一录制的关节状态序列上，比较了动作视图渲染与相机对齐骨架条件化。 总之，这些评估证明了该接口的强大能力：既可作为可恢复为可执行命令的生成表示，也可作为未来 RGB 预测的条件信号。

paragraphs.en: In summary, our contributions are as follows:
paragraphs.zh: 总而言之，我们的贡献如下：

paragraphs.en: We introduce action views , a fixed-shape multiview representation of target joint configurations that allows heterogeneous joint spaces to share a common video-modeling interface while retaining embodiment-specific geometry.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出动作视图（action views），这是一种形状固定的多视角表示方法，用于表示目标关节配置，使异构的关节空间能够共享统一的视频建模接口，同时保留各具身形态特有的几何结构。

paragraphs.en: We develop a training-free, URDF-constrained multiview recovery to map predicted action views to joint targets without a learned embodiment-specific action decoder.
paragraphs.zh: 我们开发了一种免训练的、受 URDF 约束的多视角恢复方法，无需学习特定具身形态的动作解码器，即可将预测的动作视角映射到关节目标。

paragraphs.en: Extensive experiments on simulation and real-world demonstrate that our model has strong performance on robotic manipulation and cross-view observation generation, with controlled ablation study validating the superior capability of generative visual quality.
paragraphs.zh: 在仿真和真实世界中的大量实验表明，我们的模型在机器人操作和跨视角观测生成方面具有强大的性能，并通过受控的消融实验验证了其在生成视觉质量上的卓越能力。

paragraphs.en: Unified video–action models differ in how they couple modalities and select conditioning modes ( Wang et al., 2026 ; Wen et al., 2026 ) . UVA ( Li et al., 2025 ) uses separate diffusion decoders with masked inputs, whereas UWM ( Zhu et al., 2025 ) and Pelican-Unify 1.0 ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) couples video and action diffusion with independent noise levels. The conditioning schedule and action representation are separate design choices: masking specifies which modalities are generated, whereas the representation determines how their contents encode control. Expert-based models coordinate modality-specific computation ( Bi et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2026b ) , while action-conditioned predictors such as Ctrl-World ( Guo et al., 2026 ) generate multiview rollouts from numerical controls. Recent world action models further explore task generalization and embodiment adaptation ( Ye et al., 2026 ) , efficient inference ( Yuan et al., 2026 ) , and semantic or 3D alignment ( Li et al., 2026d ; Yang et al., 2026 ) . Joint prediction and flexible conditioning are thus prior capabilities, distinct from the choice of action representation.
paragraphs.zh: 统一视频–动作模型在模态耦合方式和条件模式选择上各有不同（Wang et al., 2026；Wen et al., 2026）。 UVA（Li et al., 2025）使用带掩码输入的独立扩散解码器，而 UWM（Zhu et al., 2025）和 Pelican-Unify 1.0（Zhang et al., 2026）则将视频扩散与动作扩散以独立噪声水平相耦合。 条件调度与动作表示是相互独立的设计选择：掩码指定生成哪些模态，而表示则决定其内容如何编码控制信息。 基于专家的模型协调特定模态的计算（Bi et al., 2026；Li et al., 2026b），而诸如 Ctrl-World（Guo et al., 2026）这类以动作为条件的预测器则从数值控制生成多视角推演。 近期的世界动作模型进一步探索了任务泛化与本体（embodiment）适配（Ye et al., 2026）、高效推理（Yuan et al., 2026）以及语义或三维对齐（Li et al., 2026d；Yang et al., 2026）。 因此，联合预测与灵活条件化均属已有能力，与动作表示的选择有所区别。

paragraphs.en: Standardized vector interfaces support cross-embodiment policies ( Team et al., 2024 ; Liu et al., 2025 ) , whereas rendered representations additionally expose spatial robot geometry. Latent actions ( Bruce et al., 2024 ; Wei et al., 2026 ) and visual-motion representations ( Ko et al., 2024 ; Bi et al., 2026 ) offer alternatives to explicit joint vectors, but their conversion to executable commands depends on the chosen decoder or controller. For example, Hydra-0 ( Li et al., 2026a ) uses a trained action head, while Masked Visual Actions ( Alzayer et al., 2026 ) uses a learned inverse dynamics model. Visual interfaces differ in both the quantities they encode and their recovery mechanisms. Cosmos Policy ( Kim et al., 2026 ) encodes actions as latent frames without a separate action-generation architecture. Sharing the video backbone therefore does not necessarily imply an explicit geometric encoding of the robot. SpatialVAM ( Li et al., 2026c ) geometrically recovers end-effector positions from virtual-view heatmaps but learns rotation and gripper decoding. Action Images ( Zhen et al., 2026 ) geometrically recovers end-effector pose and gripper commands from multiview images and supports joint generation, action-conditioned prediction, and action labeling. Separately, BridgeV2W ( Chen et al., 2026 ) and GeniWorld ( Gu et al., 2026 ) condition video prediction on URDF-rendered motion aligned with observation viewpoints, requiring the corresponding camera geometry. Dream4ACT instead renders full target joint configurations in separate action-view streams and approximately recovers joint targets through URDF-constrained multiview matching. Its prescribed virtual cameras remove physical-camera extrinsic calibration from action-view construction and recovery, while the URDF supplies embodiment-specific geometry without a learned per-robot decoder head.
paragraphs.zh: 标准化的向量接口支持跨本体策略（Team et al., 2024；Liu et al., 2025），而渲染表示还额外暴露了空间机器人几何信息。 潜在动作（Bruce et al., 2024；Wei et al., 2026）和视觉运动表示（Ko et al., 2024；Bi et al., 2026）为显式关节向量提供了替代方案，但它们向可执行命令的转换取决于所选的解码器或控制器。 例如，Hydra-0（Li et al., 2026a）使用训练得到的动作头，而 Masked Visual Actions（Alzayer et al., 2026）使用学习得到的逆动力学模型。 视觉接口在其编码的量以及其恢复机制上均有所不同。 Cosmos Policy（Kim et al., 2026）将动作编码为潜在帧，而无需单独的动作生成架构。 因此，共享视频骨干并不一定意味着对机器人进行显式的几何编码。 SpatialVAM（Li et al., 2026c）从虚拟视角热图中以几何方式恢复末端执行器位置，但旋转和夹爪解码则是学习得到的。 Action Images（Zhen et al., 2026）从多视角图像中以几何方式恢复末端执行器位姿和夹爪命令，并支持关节生成、动作条件预测和动作标注。 此外，BridgeV2W（Chen et al., 2026）和 GeniWorld（Gu et al., 2026）将视频预测条件化在与观测视角对齐的 URDF 渲染运动上，这需要相应的相机几何信息。 Dream4ACT 则在单独的动作视角流中渲染完整的目标关节配置，并通过 URDF 约束的多视角匹配近似恢复关节目标。 其预定义的虚拟相机将物理相机外参标定从动作视角的构建与恢复中移除，同时 URDF 无需学习针对每个机器人的解码头即可提供特定本体的几何信息。

sents.en: Visual interfaces differ in both the quantities they encode and their recovery mechanisms.
sents.zh: 视觉接口在其编码的量以及其恢复机制上均有所不同。

sents.en: Cosmos Policy ( Kim et al., 2026 ) encodes actions as latent frames without a separate action-generation architecture.
sents.zh: Cosmos Policy（Kim et al., 2026）将动作编码为潜在帧，而无需单独的动作生成架构。

sents.en: Sharing the video backbone therefore does not necessarily imply an explicit geometric encoding of the robot.
sents.zh: 因此，共享视频骨干并不一定意味着对机器人进行显式的几何编码。

sents.en: SpatialVAM ( Li et al., 2026c ) geometrically recovers end-effector positions from virtual-view heatmaps but learns rotation and gripper decoding.
sents.zh: SpatialVAM（Li et al., 2026c）从虚拟视角热图中以几何方式恢复末端执行器位置，但旋转和夹爪解码则是学习得到的。

sents.en: Action Images ( Zhen et al., 2026 ) geometrically recovers end-effector pose and gripper commands from multiview images and supports joint generation, action-conditioned prediction, and action labeling.
sents.zh: Action Images（Zhen et al., 2026）从多视角图像中以几何方式恢复末端执行器位姿和夹爪命令，并支持关节生成、动作条件预测和动作标注。

sents.en: Separately, BridgeV2W ( Chen et al., 2026 ) and GeniWorld ( Gu et al., 2026 ) condition video prediction on URDF-rendered motion aligned with observation viewpoints, requiring the corresponding camera geometry.
sents.zh: 此外，BridgeV2W（Chen et al., 2026）和 GeniWorld（Gu et al., 2026）将视频预测条件化在与观测视角对齐的 URDF 渲染运动上，这需要相应的相机几何信息。

sents.en: Dream4ACT instead renders full target joint configurations in separate action-view streams and approximately recovers joint targets through URDF-constrained multiview matching.
sents.zh: Dream4ACT 则在单独的动作视角流中渲染完整的目标关节配置，并通过 URDF 约束的多视角匹配近似恢复关节目标。

sents.en: Its prescribed virtual cameras remove physical-camera extrinsic calibration from action-view construction and recovery, while the URDF supplies embodiment-specific geometry without a learned per-robot decoder head.
sents.zh: 其预定义的虚拟相机将物理相机外参标定从动作视角的构建与恢复中移除，同时 URDF 无需学习针对每个机器人的解码头即可提供特定本体的几何信息。

paragraphs.en: Dream4ACT uses a shared visual action interface (Figure 2 ). URDF rendering converts current and target joint configurations into four fixed virtual-camera action views (Section 3.1 ), while a trainable adapter over a frozen VLM extracts instruction-grounded conditions (Section 3.2 ). A shared video VAE separately encodes RGB and action-view sequences into latent tokens (Section 3.3 ). Conditioned on the adapter outputs, a diffusion transformer jointly models these tokens under masked flow matching, supporting forward dynamics, inverse dynamics, and joint generation (Section 3.4 ). Finally, training-free URDF-constrained Gauss–Newton matching recovers joint targets from generated action views (Section 3.5 ).

paragraphs.en: We evaluate our model along three complementary axes: closed-loop manipulation, nulti embodiments capability and action-conditioned multiview prediction.
paragraphs.zh: 我们沿着三个互补的维度评估我们的模型：闭环操作、多本体能力和动作条件的多视角预测。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate closed-loop manipulation capability on RoboTwin 2.0 ( Chen et al., 2025 ) , a simulation benchmark comprising 50 bimanual manipulation tasks. We collect 2,500 clean and 25,000 randomized demonstrations, corresponding to 50 and 500 demonstrations per task, respectively. Randomization varies backgrounds, tabletop objects, and lighting.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在 RoboTwin 2.0（Chen 等，2025）上评估闭环操作能力，该基准是一个包含 50 个双手操作任务的仿真基准。 我们收集了 2,500 条干净示范和 25,000 条随机化示范，分别对应每个任务 50 条和 500 条示范。 随机化包括背景、桌面物体和光照的变化。

paragraphs.en: To evaluate action-conditioned world modeling, we use TriWorldBench ( Liu et al., 2026 ) , which assesses generated videos from synchronized head and wrist cameras. We reuse the same checkpoint without benchmark-specific fine-tuning and switch to forward dynamics mode. Given the evaluation action trajectories, we render the corresponding action-view sequences for conditioning. Following the official submission protocol, we generate corresponding head and wrist videos per episode, with frame counts matching the supplied trajectory lengths, for official evaluation.
paragraphs.zh: 为了评估动作条件下的世界建模，我们使用 TriWorldBench（Liu et al., 2026），它通过同步的头部和腕部相机评估生成的视频。 我们复用同一个检查点，不做针对基准的微调，并切换到前向动力学模式。 给定评估用的动作轨迹，我们渲染相应的动作视角序列作为条件输入。 按照官方提交协议，我们为每个回合生成相应的头部和腕部视频，帧数与提供的轨迹长度一致，用于官方评估。

paragraphs.en: Table 3 shows that our model achieves success rates of 90.50% and 87.46% under clean and randomized settings, respectively, averaging 88.98%. Compared with publicly reported results, Dream4ACT exceeds π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} by 7.76 and 10.7 percentage points and slightly higher than Motus, while LingBot-VA and Fast-WAM achieve higher scores. paragraphs.en: In forward dynamics mode, Dream4ACT achieves a TWB-Score of 65.66, comparable to BWM’s 65.54 (Table 4 ). Among the listed methods, our method obtains the highest reported P3D, MQ, and TC scores and ties BWM on VQ. Its TVC and TA scores are 81.63 and 84.22, respectively, compared with BWM’s 81.87 and 86.05, showing competitive cross-view consistency and task alignment. paragraphs.en: We presented Dream4ACT, a video–action world model for joint-controlled manipulation that represents target joint configurations as fixed-shape action views. Masked flow matching supports forward dynamics, inverse dynamics, and joint generation, while training-free URDF-constrained matching recovers joint targets for execution. Experiments on RoboTwin2.0 and real robots show that the same weights support closed-loop control across multiple jointly trained embodiments and our forward dynamics provides high quality task-aligned multi-view generation.

paragraphs.en: The demonstrated scope of Dream4ACT is bounded by its training data and embodiment coverage. Our evaluation includes five simulated embodiments and four real-world platforms; broader task coverage and transfer to unseen embodiments remain to be validated. Recovery requires an embodiment-specific URDF and rendering conventions consistent with those used during training (Appendices A.2 and A.3 ). Kinematic mismatch can affect physical execution, while joint-recovery accuracy also depends on generated-view fidelity and geometric observability. Explicit multiview generation and numerical action recovery incur substantial latency: in our real-world setup, they take approximately 6.9 s and 2.7 s, respectively, per 80-step chunk (Appendix A.4 ). The current implementation therefore supports chunk-based execution rather than real-time, per-step replanning. Expanding demonstration and embodiment coverage, improving robustness to geometric mismatch, and accelerating generation and recovery are promising directions for extending this shared action interface while retaining recovery without learned embodiment-specific decoders.
paragraphs.zh: Dream4ACT 所展示的能力范围受限于其训练数据与具身形态的覆盖范围。 我们的评估包含五种仿真具身形态和四个真实世界平台；更广的任务覆盖以及对未见具身形态的迁移仍有待验证。 恢复需要与训练时所用的渲染约定相一致的、特定于具身形态的 URDF（附录 A.2 和 A.3）。 运动学不匹配会影响物理执行，而关节恢复的准确性还取决于生成视角的保真度与几何可观测性。 显式的多视角生成和数值化的动作恢复会带来可观的延迟：在我们的真实世界设置中，每个 80 步的动作块分别需要约 6.9 秒和 2.7 秒（附录 A.4）。 因此，当前实现支持的是基于动作块的执行，而非实时的逐步重规划。 扩大演示与具身形态的覆盖范围、提升对几何不匹配的鲁棒性、以及加速生成与恢复，是拓展这一共享动作接口的有前景的方向，同时在不依赖学习到的特定具身形态解码器的情况下保留恢复能力。
